FisherPoseStudio.description: 1–3 people with independent poses and positions sharing one camera. Connect the prompt to prompt, the framed mannequin pose image to image_2 and the source image directly to image_1. In camera-only mode, leave the pose image output unconnected.

FisherQwenPose.description: For Qwen Image 2.1. Connect person reference images 1–3 in order; the mannequin reference is added internally as the last image and bound to the positive prompt. Auto: with one image, all people share image 1; with several, they map in person-list order. Images added in the editor are only for skeleton fitting and do not replace these inputs.

use_default_template.name: use_default_template
use_default_template.tooltip: Use Qwen's full PE system template from system_prompt_edit.txt (not included; place it in the plugin folder yourself). When off, or when the file is missing, a short template that only keeps the JSON output rules is used.

FisherQwenFreePose.description: Qwen Image 2.1 free pose (single person). For the VNCCS_QI2_PoseStudio LoRA: the mannequin image is image1, the person image is image2 and the prompt is fixed to Draw character from image2. The mannequin size is set in the editor; the node's width/height only set the output size (a resolution node can be connected) and need not match it.

vision_source.name: vision_source
vision_source.tooltip: The matching mmproj F16 GGUF, or a full Qwen3-VL-8B safetensors to take the vision weights from.
